en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a wide tree‑lined boulevard receding toward low green hills. Elegant multi‑story European‑style buildings line the left side while lower structures and greenery appear on the right. Tram tracks run along the center of the unpaved street. At the bottom left the caption reads "Salonique – Turquie." and at the lower right "Boulevard Hamidieh." There is additional text at the top in Ottoman Turkish script.
